build_lance_config: create a LanceConfig with custom features, columns, and batch_size for loading Lance datasets
resolve_dataset_uris: resolve Lance dataset root URIs from a list of file paths inside _transactions or _versions directories
fix_hf_uri: strip the revision tag from a Hugging Face hf:// URI so Lance can load it
fix_local_version_file: replace a symlinked local _versions file with its real content to fix Lance loading
generate_tables_from_lance_fragments: yield PyArrow tables keyed by fragment and batch index from Lance dataset fragments or LanceFileReaders
